newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad meets Lebanon's premier Hariri.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad meets Lebanon's premier Hariri.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad held talks with Lebanese caretaker Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri in Damascus on Thursday on bilateral ties and regional developments.
Presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh gave no details on the meeting which was held at the presidential palace in the Syrian capital.

Hariri's visit to Syria -- a main foreign power broker in Lebanon where it has some 35,000 troops -- came a few hours before his expected nomination by Lebanese President Elias Hrawi to form a new government.
